title: Birthday Budget Entry Budget Amount Leaderboard
dataSources: Gift registries (`gift:registry`), Amazon wishlists (`amazon:wishlist`), holiday card sends (`holiday:card`), birthday budgets (`birthday:budget`), and thank-you notes (`thankyou:note`).
app: Gift registry exports, Amazon wishlist snapshots, holiday card mail logs, birthday budget trackers, and thank-you note reminders ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=birthday:budget budget_usd=*
| stats sum(budget_usd) as total_value, avg(budget_usd) as avg_value by recipient_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks recipient values by total and average budget amount across birthday budget entry events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `budget_usd` values for each birthday budget entry event and review total and average budget amount by recipient.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total budget amount.
grandmaExplanation: It produces which recipient shows the biggest budget amount numbers in your birthday budget entry data.
